explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. I grepped Mathlib for `dualSubmodule` in the NumberField directory and for `idealLattice` and `fractionalIdealLatticeBasis` across Mathlib. I also grepped for `traceForm_mixedSpace` and for `dualSubmodule` or `dual` combined with `mixed`. Mathlib has `idealLattice`, `span_idealLatticeBasis`, `dualSubmodule_span_of_basis` and `Submodule.traceDual_span_of_basis`, which this proof uses as ingredients. None of them says that the dual of the ideal lattice under the flipped trace form on the mixed space is the image of the fractional-ideal dual. Getting there needs the dual-basis computation `hdb` and the image comparison, so it is not a one- or two-line instantiation.
